$comment: Anchor home domains the scheduled attester probes.
Adding a domain here does NOT assert anything about it — the job probes it
and records whatever it finds, including a total failure. That is the point:
a registry is only useful if it is willing to record that an anchor does not
work. Open a PR to add one.
testanchor.stellar.org is the SDF test anchor. It currently advertises SEP-31
and returns an empty receive list, so it attests as NOT serving SEP-31 — a
useful demonstration that the registry reports capability rather than claims.
cowrie.exchange is a real production anchor (Cowrie Exchange, Lagos, Nigeria;
see corridors/ng-cowrie.corridor.yaml). Confirmed 2026-08-11 by running the
probe against it directly: SEP-10 auth and SEP-31 (receives NGNT, USDC) both
pass; no SEP-38 quote server is published.
